phrase.zh: 微小的变化，也有长远的回声。

visual.zh: 果蝇身体居中，双翅向左右展开，翅脉、分节身体与六条细腿以刻线和点描塑形，周围保留安静背景。
visual.en: A centered fly spreads two wings across the image; engraved lines and stippling shape the veins, segmented body and six slender legs against a quiet field.

background.zh:
穆勒研究果蝇的遗传特征，发现X射线照射能够增加遗传突变。他因发现通过X射线照射产生突变，获得1946年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。画面的放大果蝇指代研究对象，是原创标本式插画，不复原某一只实验果蝇，也不把翅形或颜色变化当作他的实验结果。短句为原创。
1946年生理学或医学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：发现可以通过X射线照射产生突变。
background.en:
Muller studied fruit-fly heredity and found that X-ray exposure increased genetic mutations. He received the 1946 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discovering the production of mutations by X-ray irradiation. The enlarged fly is an original specimen-style illustration of the research organism, not a reconstruction of an experimental fly or a claim that its wing shape or color is a reported mutation. The phrase is original.
1946 — The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for the discovery of the production of mutations by means of X-ray irradiation
